newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Shanghai places HK$224 mln new shrs.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai places HK$224 mln new shrs.

text.p: First Shanghai Investments Ltd said on Thursday it would issue 147.83 million new shares to controlling shareholder International Enterprises Investment Co Ltd (IEI), raising net proceeds of HK$224 million.

First Shanghai said its parent had agreed to place 90.09 million existing company shares to private and institutional investors at HK$1.54 each before it subscribed the 147.83 million new shares at a net placing price after expenses.
On completion of the placement on May 19 and the subscription on June 2, IEI's shareholding will remain unchanged at 39.08 percent, the statement said.
The stake of Artrel Ltd will be diluted to 0.13 percent from 0.15 percent following the deal, it said.
IEI is equally owned by China Venturetech Investment Corp and Shenyin Wanguo Securities Co Ltd.

Of the proceeds, about HK$80 million will be used for the manufacture of children's products in China and HK$80 million for repayment of bank borrowings, with the balance for working capital, the company said.
Trading in First Shanghai shares is scheduled to resume on Thursday after a one-day suspension. The shares ended at HK$1.81 on Tuesday.
